meta.title: Memory
meta.description: Cross-session long-term memory: saves user preferences, project facts, and decisions as hand-editable Markdown entries, recalls them into new sessions by category priority within a character budget, and ranks searches by relevance; the Memory Atlas panel has Memories and Settings tabs — distribution bar, category-accent cards, tag shortcuts, bulk selection, delete undo, JSON export/import, plus injection/privacy/backup/panel settings (live settings.json overlay, automatic backups); never stores passwords, keys, or tokens.
